changelog:
- Initial release of MayuBench v1.0 — an AI-native behavior benchmark.
- Provides 144 scenario-based questions across 8 behavioral dimensions and a six-level scoring framework.
- Includes manual, automated, and arena-based testing methods.
- All documentation is now available in English.
- Maintains full open-source licensing (MIT-0) and a standardized, reproducible structure.
